title: Betsy’s Runaway Bear
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road. In Chapter 13, Jemmy runs into a bear in a forest clearing. Build the clearing, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is a clearing in the forest, from Chapters 13 and 14. Jemmy meets a bear there. Then Betsy comes looking for it.

models.name: White Horse - Running
models.why: soldiers ride on the river road

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **bear** in an open spot. Put the **rope** and the **bee** by the bear. Put the **horse** off to the side.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “The prince won’t go back with the soldiers because ___. I know because ___.”
steps.text: Point to the horse and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to the horse and say this out loud. The prince won’t go back with the soldiers because… I know because…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the bear, the rope, the bee and the horse

extra.text: Find a big tree. Pretend it is **hollow**, like Jemmy’s. Say why it was a smart place to hide.

points: Your photo shows the bear, the rope, the bee and the horse in a forest clearing.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each sentence and decide: is it in the book, or not? Then finish two sentences about the prince.
mapday.miss: Not quite. Think back to Chapters 13 and 14.
mapday.done: ✓ You sorted every sentence. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A forest clearing with a spot for In the book and a spot for Not in the book

clues.q: Jemmy hides from Cutwater inside a hollow tree.
The bear chases Jemmy up a tree.
Betsy holds out a chunk of comb honey.
Betsy says the river is due north.
The prince runs to the soldiers so he can go home.
The prince says, “This is the best time I ever had!”

hints: no one fusses about his dirty clothes

hints: waited for it to run away
